reference.description: The verse he asks about: 'Romans 8:28', or a passage under a heading ('Romans 8:1-11').

greek.description: The Greek of the verse (the Byzantine text), in Greek word order.

english.description: The same verse in English (the Majority Standard Bible); words the translators supplied are between asterisks.

question.description: What he asked, at most 400 characters.

solid_words.description: The Greek lemmas he already knows well.

learner.description: Optional. Where he stands in one line: 'solid N words; learning: a, b, c; new today: x, y; due now: M'.

learner_grammar.description: Optional. Where his grammar stands, as in the Bible talk's request (grinds/bible-talk.input.schema.json learner_grammar).

settings.description: Optional. How he wants a language besides Greek written, and how Ask the tutor opens (askBy: "speaking" or "typing"), by key: { "hebrewDepth": "both", "askBy": "speaking" }.
